name: Light Curtain

width.label: Protected width (m)
width.desc: The clear gap between the two columns, which the beams span. The part origin is its centre, on the floor.

fieldBottom.label: Lowest beam (m)
fieldBottom.desc: Height of the bottom beam above the floor. Where a conveyor passes through, put it just above the conveying surface: nothing can pass below that.

fieldHeight.label: Beam span (m)
fieldHeight.desc: From the lowest beam to the highest. The four beams are spread evenly across it, and the columns stand 0.1 m above the top one.

showBeam.label: Show beams
showBeam.desc: Draw the beams in the viewport. A viewing aid only - hiding them does not change what the curtain sees.

enableComms.label: Enable comms
enableComms.desc: Connect this part to a PLC program. Its tags appear once this is on.

tag.label: OSSD tag (true = clear)
tag.desc: The safety output: true while every beam is clear, false while anything interrupts one. Muting a load through is the program's job: feed this and the muting sensors to a muting block, and its output into the run permit.

mutingLampTag.label: Muting lamp tag
mutingLampTag.desc: Optional: the program lights the muting lamp on the emitter's cap with this while it is muting the curtain.
